card.name: Ending of infusion and effusion
card.fires_on: The final piece of the long words 'infusion' and 'effusion' (usions/ION), mostly after 'eff' in 'pericardial effusions' or after 'INFUS' in capitalized warnings about infusion rate.

modes.label: Effusions
modes.description: The ending 'usions' of 'effusions' after pleural, pericardial or choroidal.
modes.example: pulmonary infiltrates, pleural or pericardial eff<<usions>>, rapid weight gain or peripheral edema

modes.label: Infusion in capitals
modes.description: The ending 'ION' of 'INFUSION' in all-caps warnings about rate or duration.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOVASCULAR RISK ASSOCIATED WITH RAPID INFUS<<ION>>

card.plain: It fires on the last part of the words effusion and infusion when they are split into pieces.
